=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:202-296 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: heal_prepush_test_gate() runs the repair turn (`run_editor "${root}/repair-prompt-tests" || rc=$?`) with no check on elapsed or remaining time, and `run_editor` is bounded only by `wall="${HEAL_ISOLATED_EDITOR_WALL_SECS:-${EDITOR_MAX_WALL:-7800}}"` (line 67). The review path (rpg_step_budget=3300, editor_timeout) and the resolver path (gate_budget_end=9000) both have budget guards.
  WHY: The gate run (~720s), a repair turn of up to 7800s and validate_snapshot (600s) can push the job past implement.yml's `timeout-minutes: 180` (implement.yml line 131). GitHub then cancels it before the scoped `transfer` at line 297, so the validated heal edit, commit and push are lost. This violates "The push is never blocked". All four reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:987-1016 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The repair budget counts `CONFLICT_RESOLVER_PER_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_SECS` plus `gate_wall`. But `_resolver_sandbox_attempt` (883-909) calls `prepare-ephemeral` outside that attempt timeout. On the Codex path this runs `_review_sandbox_build_image 0` (scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:122), which has no build timeout and can retry.
  WHY: A slow or retrying image preparation can use up the time reserved for the commit. The resolver step then hits its 170-minute timeout before `git commit`, even with the new budget guard.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:967-975 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The step budget check at line 967 reserves `gate_wall + 600`, but the prepare-ephemeral call at line 975 is `timeout --kill-after=30s 600 ...`, so its worst case is 630s.
  WHY: An orphaned sandbox build that ignores SIGTERM for the 30s kill-after window can overrun the 9000s budget by up to 30s before the second check (line 1019) runs. That leaves no margin for the `[ai-merge-resolve]` commit reserve. The agents.md change says "600 s".
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2835-2848 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The "Run Codex implementation" step does not pass `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_MODE` to the heal script. The `mode` call at scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:224-226 therefore uses the gate's default, `repair`.
  WHY: The configured kill switch (`off`) does not disable the heal gate or its repair turn, so this path keeps running under the default mode.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

The agents fragment ("Mode reach") and the changelog acknowledge the gap, but the issue does not defer it: the deferral rests only on the files_touched grant. It needs one env line, the same pattern as review_autofix.yml:4043, and no change to scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh. A follow-up issue is needed if the grant cannot be widened.
- requirement: "Heal, `scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh`: ... run the gate against `${root}/source` with the same image and limits as `validate_snapshot`."
  expected_change_site: scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh heal_prepush_test_gate gate invocation (lines 247-249), or the resource limits in scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh
  confidence=5

  EVIDENCE: Only the timeout was matched (`PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES=10` at scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:247-249). validate_snapshot uses a 600s timeout, `--pids-limit 128 --memory 2g` and a 128 MB tmpfs (scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:154-159). The wrapper applies `--pids-limit 512`, `--memory 4g`, a 512 MB tmpfs, a 720s wrapper timeout and a 30s kill grace (scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:251-255). The agents fragment confirms the wrapper's own limits still apply. Image and network/credential posture match, so the impact is limited to resource limits. The editor deferred this because of the file scope grant.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:heal_prepush_test_gate(), lines 275-276 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `rc=0` then `run_editor "${root}/repair-prompt-tests" || rc=$?` runs with no elapsed-time check. run_editor (lines 105-147) is bounded only by `timeout --kill-after=30s "${wall}"`, and line 67 sets `wall="${HEAL_ISOLATED_EDITOR_WALL_SECS:-${EDITOR_MAX_WALL:-7800}}"`. The review path (rpg_step_budget, rpg_run_wall, editor_timeout) and the resolver path (gate_budget_end=9000, gate_attempt_secs + gate_wall) have budget guards; heal has none.
  WHY: Under implement.yml's `timeout-minutes: 180` (line 131), a slow first heal turn followed by a gate failure can push the job past 180 minutes. The job is cancelled before the scoped `transfer` on line 297, so nothing is committed or pushed. This breaks "The push is never blocked". Suggested fix: record SECONDS at script start and skip the repair (`repair=skipped reason=step_budget`) or pass a reduced wall.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: "Done when: ... Mode `off` and a missing module are no-ops." and "Rollback: Set `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_MODE=off`, then revert."
  Expected change site: the env block of the .github/workflows/implement.yml "Run Codex implementation" step, which runs scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh at line 3659 and sets EDITOR_MAX_WALL and HEAL_ISOLATED_EDITOR_WALL_SECS at lines 2846-2847, or equivalent forwarding to heal_prepush_test_gate.
  Evidence of absence: No hunk forwards PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_MODE. `bash "${gate_step}" mode` falls back to `repair`. The issue does not defer this; the editor deferred it only because of the files_touched grant.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  Requirement: "Heal ... run the gate against `${root}/source` with the same image and limits as `validate_snapshot`."
  Expected change site: the heal_prepush_test_gate gate invocation in scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh (around line 248), or the container limits in scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh.
  Evidence of absence: Only the timeout matches (`PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES=10`). validate_snapshot uses `--pids-limit 128 --memory 2g --tmpfs /tmp:...size=128m` (lines 154-156), and the gate keeps the wrapper's limits.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh _resolver_prepush_test_gate, two repair budget checks `$(( gate_attempt_secs + gate_wall ))`. `prepare-ephemeral` (line 883) runs outside the per-attempt `timeout` (line 906). Fix: use `gate_attempt_secs + gate_wall + 630` (2 lines).
- HARDENING: scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh heal_prepush_test_gate, before `run_editor "${root}/repair-prompt-tests"`. Record `heal_started=${SECONDS}` and skip the repair when `SECONDS - heal_started + wall + 600` exceeds the budget (default 9600 s). Log `outcome=fail repair=skipped reason=step_budget` (5 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
